scope: Independent read-only runner, fixed-budget, qualification and resume review; focused synthetic execution only

focused_tests.scope: Tiny-policy optimizer/private-global-RNG serialization and resumed next update; fixed-boundary evaluation guards; exact failure/rollback evidence copies; pending/completed final-resume semantics; authenticated paired qualification prerequisites

reviewed_semantics: Initialization recomposes the archived original CNN/LSTM/action readout with the same archived fresh critic, authenticates source assets, and compares the full composed policy to the existing initialization archive.

The command-line training path authenticates both complete qualification audits and both original-policy hashes, requiring 192 successes among 256 valid cases for each population before any training setup.

Exactly three blocks of 1024 updates times 32 trials are prescribed. The cap sequence is 0,15,45; one private integer is drawn per training batch including cap0, and all six private generator states are checkpointed.
Forty-six-bin per-block delay histograms reconcile updates, waiting updates and active physics counts; padding and setup pickups are accounted separately.

The original full11-branch memory baseline is pending at update0. The first two fixed block boundaries require the three interim branches; the fixed final requires all11. Learning cannot cross an unrecorded boundary.

All parameters participate in the original RMSProp/loss conventions. Stored-input replay is checked against rollout logits and values before each optimizer step; waits have no actor/entropy action loss.
Evaluation verifies preservation of policy, optimizer, private generators, global generators and train/eval mode.
Resumes restore full policy/optimizer/private/global RNG at a completed-trial boundary and retain exact restart bytes, inherited accepted endpoints, failed plans and rolled-back metrics.

A pending final evaluation executes once without more learning. Resuming an already completed final executes neither learning nor evaluation; latest retains the final pre-evaluation checkpoint role while the exact supplied final remains separate restart evidence.

Process deadline checks preserve a resumable boundary; the independent provider deletion deadline remains the external hard stop. No automatic extension or favorable checkpoint selection is implemented.
